scope: Descriptive calibration on complete m1-natural source L_s and held-out source V. No U labels, U IQ, target data, training or checkpoint selection.
reason: r01 stopped before data measurement because the legacy PL config lacks paper_row; r02 stopped during historical checkpoint loading because frozen release bootstrap was missing. r03 applies both fixes and uses a new immutable run. Read-only CPU checks loaded the legacy PL and new day_physics model and executed the five-branch bounded-echo certificate on source samples without U or target access.
method: Evaluate frozen same-contract PL, Tri, day and day_physics E50 for all three seeds. Measure source V accuracy, threshold-0.95 acceptance and accepted errors overall, by day and by transmitter. Build true-L class centroids separately for five branches, excluding queried source day; evaluate four-vote agreement on raw and bounded-echo features. Full L bank and bounded echo are diagnostic approximations, not a minibatch As-gate replay or hidden-U-truth measurement.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --source-probe --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
environment: N607 ordinary account; immutable release and unique output root; GPU 0–7, no more than two observed/pending processes per GPU including other owners.
stop_rule: Stop on invalid source roles, contract, missing frozen parent or technical failure; preserve logs and outputs. No target scoring or training.
expected_artifacts: Five-branch raw and bounded-echo source-V certificate counts
U and target access counts of zero
